t: 利沃尼亚骑士团在艾兹克劳克勒战役被立陶宛大公国击败.
te: The Livonian Order is defeated in the Battle of Aizkraukle by the Grand Duchy of Lithuania.
dz: 利沃尼亚骑士团在艾兹克劳克勒战役被立陶宛大公国击败.
de: The Livonian Order is defeated in the Battle of Aizkraukle by the Grand Duchy of Lithuania.

t: 亚门战役中蒙古的胜利结束了中国的宋朝.
te: A Mongol victory at the Battle of Yamen ends the Song dynasty in China.
dz: 亚门战役中蒙古的胜利结束了中国的宋朝.
de: A Mongol victory at the Battle of Yamen ends the Song dynasty in China.

t: 佛教尼一伦·什什ū分会成立于日本.
te: The Nichiren Shōshū branch of Buddhism is founded in Japan.
dz: 佛教尼一伦·什什ū分会成立于日本.
de: The Nichiren Shōshū branch of Buddhism is founded in Japan.
